data.name: Interactive Animal Encounter
data.headline: Design your animal meet and greet
data.description:
Create new memories during customizable animal encounters at Helen Woodward Animal Center! This animal education opportunity is a perfect activity for any animal lover and works well with playgroups, youth groups, 4H groups, home school groups, families, and retirement homes. You will not only get hands-on animal interactions but will also gain a better understanding of our furred, feathered, and scaled friends.

Program defaults as 60-minute but you can select the 'extra time program' per participant to extend it to a 90-minute program for even more fun!

* A minimum of 6 participants is required to make this booking. You may bring less participants on the day of the program, but we will not refund the difference if less than 6 participants attend, as that is the minimum cost we need to run the program.
data.itinerary:
* The program will begin with a brief introduction and set up rules and expectations.
* Rotate animals and locations about every 15 minutes depending on species. Typically we introduce the individual animal then talk about its species based on the focus of the selected theme, allowing for interaction and questions near the end of the presentation.
* Rotate activities and locations every 30 minutes depending on activity type.
* If your group doesn't have great walking accessibility, we will diminish the amount of room changing we do, but please let us know ahead of time in the booking comments so we can plan ahead accordingly.

meeting_point.address: 6447 Helen Woodward Way Rancho Santa Fe, CA US 92067

data.what_is_included:
* 90-minute programs include: 4 animals to meet and 1 activity to participate in, focusing on the theme you selected to guide the learning.

* 60-minute programs include: 3 animals to meet and 1 activity to participate in, focusing on the theme you selected to guide the learning.

If you would like a different combination of these options (all animals no activities, less animals and more activities), please contact us once your program is booked and we can modify it for you.
data.what_is_not_included: Food and drinks aren't provided or readily available onsite. We have water bottle refill stations.
what_is_not_included_items: Food and drinks aren't provided or readily available onsite. We have water bottle refill stations.
data.cancellation_notes:
- We operate rain or shine.
- Canceling 31+ days prior: Will result in a refund of 75% of the paid value.
- Canceling within 30 days of your scheduled event: Will result in no refund.
- Rescheduling 31+ days prior: Will result in a fee of 30% of the paid value.
- We will allow your program to be rescheduled without a penalty for up to 3 business days once it has been booked. We are not able to reschedule within 30 days of your scheduled event and you will not receive a refund.
data.booking_notes:
#We are looking forward to seeing you!
#Check In Procedure
Meet at Education in the large covered pavilion. Plan to arrive 10 minutes before your program start time. Late arrival results in a shorter program with less time for animal interaction. Your instructor(s) will be waiting for you at the Education Department


##Other Notes
Typical programs require you to select 3 animals to meet and participate in 1 activity. If you would like a different combination of these options, please contact us once your program is booked.
data.check_in_details: Check-in with the Lobby and your assigned Instructor will guide you and your group back to the starting area. Your entire group does **not** need to be present to check-in.
data.special_requirements:
* Must be at least 5-years old to pet reptiles.
* Chaperones required for anyone under 18 years old, and as needed for elderly assistance.
data.restrictions: * For this program there is a group maximum of 20 people. Ask us about adjustments to this maximum at the time of booking and we may be able to accommodate depending on the day and time.
data.health_and_safety_notes: To ensure the health and safety of our program participants, staff, and animals, please read our Health and Safety Policy by clicking the link below.
data.disclaimers: * Species may vary depending on animal health, safety and availability.
